mechanisms.formula: Standard Kuramoto oscillator integrator producing R(t) order parameter.
mechanisms.validity: KuramotoConfig(N:int, omega:array[N], K:float, dt:float, steps:int); finite, dt > 0, K ≥ 0.
mechanisms.input_contract: KuramotoConfig(N:int, omega:array[N], K:float, dt:float, steps:int); finite, dt > 0, K ≥ 0.
mechanisms.output_contract: R: array[steps] with 0 ≤ R(t) ≤ 1; phases mod 2π; finite.
mechanisms.falsifier: INV-K2: R > 3/√N after 10⁴ steps with K = 0.1·K_c, N > 100 ⇒ violation. INV-OA2 algebraic: K > 2Δ ⇒ R_∞ = √(1−2Δ/K) to float precision.
